edges.hint.label: How the edges are computed
edges.hint.measured: How the edges are computed. Connectivity λ is measured by a design of experiments: injection is perturbed well by well, simulator runs are repeated, and λ is read off the production response. It is not the distance between wells and not the pad geometry. Response lag: {lag}. Stability across run batches: {stability}. Rank of the response matrix: {rank}. Condition number: {condition}.
edges.hint.unmeasured: How the edges are computed. Connectivity λ is not measured for this scenario: no design of experiments on perturbed runs was made. The edges are shown as they come from the artifact, with no stability or condition numbers behind them.
